component.name: Seabass
component.summary: Keep the rekordbox and Engine DJ libraries on a USB stick in step

description.p: Seabass is a toolbox for DJ USB sticks. A stick prepared for both Pioneer and Denon gear carries two or three independent copies of the same library, and they do not talk to each other: set a hot cue in one and the others never hear about it. Seabass treats those copies as one library written several times, and keeps them honest.

ul.li: Browse the library on a stick, with waveforms, hot cues and playback
Sync cue points between rekordbox and Engine DJ
Full backups of a stick, and restoring them onto any drive
Back up cues, ratings and other metadata, and restore them later
Find and clean up duplicate tracks, resolving conflicting cues by hand
Library health checks that find and repair missing files
Statistics about a library and health checks for the stick itself

description.p: Seabass works on the library already on your stick. It makes no network request unless you switch on the update check.
